issues.description: The intermediate Child::None allocation path assumes that the current PTE address owns an unused-PTE token immediately before consuming that linear token.
issues.rationale: At problem line 571, assume(unused_pte_addrs.contains_key(cur_entry.pte.pte_paddr())) manufactures the exact membership required by the following tracked_remove and Entry::replace. If the key is absent, no linear ownership token is derivable. Repair ea0e7a3 adds exact SPT/token complement clauses and the unpacked mpt_and_tokens_wf_addrs loop invariant, then removes this local assumption.
